ValidationRule.description: Validate Phone Format for BR Accounts and Phone Lenght
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c), $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'Administrador do sistema', $Profile.Name <> 'API Only profile', NOT(CONTAINS($Profile.Name, "Master Data")), ISPICKVAL(BillingCountryCode, "BR"), NOT(REGEX(Phone, "^((\\+\\d{2}\\s)?\\(\\d{2}\\)\\s?\\d{4}\\d?\\-\\d{4})?$")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Phone Number lenght should not exceed 11 digits. For Brazil, please adjust Phone format to: (00) 00000-0000
